newsitem.title: EGYPT: UAE, Qatar delegates in Cairo for Mideast meeting.
newsitem.headline: UAE, Qatar delegates in Cairo for Mideast meeting.

text.p: Delegates from the Gulf states of Qatar and the United Arab Emirates arrived in Cairo on Sunday to take part in a conference aimed at integrating the region's economy, airport officials said.
The UAE Foreign Affairs Minister Rashid Abdullah al-Nuaimi will head his country's delegation to the two-day Middle East and North Africa Conference which opens in Cairo on Tuesday.
Qatar's Sheikh Hamad bin Mohamed bin Jassim al Thani, head of the Qatari Chamber of Commerce and Industry, will also attend the conference with a 17 member delegation.
"This conference represents what is good for the Arab nation and its economy," Nuaimi told reporters on arrival.
Official and private sector representatives from more than 80 countries are due to attend the Cairo conference, which is the third of its kind since 1994.
The previous two conferences were intended to integrate Israel in the regional economy after peace deals with the Palestinians.
